title: Rentaro Breaks Against A Wall — Part 6

series.summary: Shut out of the house, Rentaro collapses against a wall, drowns in memories of Hakari, and by nightfall says something the others refuse to argue with.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro hits the wall and folds over it. His palm flattens against the stone and the sound tears straight out of his chest.
Memories wash in white behind him. A child's hand inside his. A kiss. A photograph with every single one of them together.
By nightfall he is upright again and saying it out loud. The others look up at him, and not one of them argues.
They gather under a single lamp in an empty playground, standing close, waiting for him to finish the sentence he just started.
